subject: Television & Streaming
title: British Brevity: Why UK Shows Are Short
description: Learn British Brevity: Why UK Shows Are Short in one minute.

hook.text: Fawlty Towers had 12 episodes. The Office UK had 14. Fleabag had 12.

buildup.text: In the UK, writers typically have more control. They decide when a show ends.

twist.text: American networks often remake British shows with longer runs.

climax.text: British brevity reflects a philosophy: better to leave audiences wanting more than to exhaust a premise.

punchline.text: The best shows know when to stop.

quiz.question: Why do British TV shows typically have shorter runs than American ones?
options: Writers have more control over when a show ends, prioritizing quality over extending profitable shows
